moves.why: The only game in the clip is football played on the beach ('People play football by the sea'); he waves her over to join it. Ballgames is defined as games other than football. Ballgames keeps 12 at B.

names.why: In British English 'athletics' means track and field only (the key word 'athletics', 53, shows exactly that), yet the tile holds archery, ice hockey, skating, skiing, snowboard, surfing, rowing, sailing, biathlon, boxing, weights and paintball. Nearly all of these are Olympic sports, so 'Olympics' reads true for the tile; only tug of war, rollerblades, paintball, the pit stop and the bullet clip fall outside.

notes: 7134 'footballer' shows American football, so by the clip it is right in Ballgames, but the key word next to a tile named Football will look odd; left in place. 5559 'appointment' (captain's armband in a hall with basketball hoops) shows no identifiable sport; left in Football. 69 barbell, 251 dumbbell, 591 punching bag belong to Fitness by content, but no move across old groups.
